newsitem.title: USA: General Binding buys firm with $150 mln in sales.
newsitem.headline: General Binding buys firm with $150 mln in sales.

text.p: General Binding Corp, which provides binding and laminating systems, said Tuesday it agreed to acquire for cash Quartet Manufacturing Co, a Skokie, Ill.-based company with projected 1996 revenues of $150 million.
Quartet makes and distributes visual communications products including markerboards, bulletin boards and easels.
Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
The transaction, which is to be effective as of January 1, 1997, will close in early January, subject to obtaining necessary regulatory approvals, General Binding said.
